question: Can closed-loop 3-stage Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design (BOED) spectroscopy anchored to Exp125 RF SNR (0.0627 ms/pt @ 20 mK) break the 1.0 s/candidate readout bottleneck by 5-15x at $0 extra hardware cost while sharpening frequency precision to <=100 Hz, and can CellISA v3.0 compile/route multi-cell M4 cavity-bus programs on heterogeneous 51%-yield wafers?

model.rf_snr: Exp125 20 mK Elzerman readout (1.4 K LNA, -100 dBm/tone, Ql=1000, |dGamma|=0.05): tau_SNR10 = 0.062705 ms, SNR(tau) = 10 * sqrt(tau / 0.062705 ms); sensitivity check at 3.0 K LNA (0.1332 ms) and 1 K PSB (0.179 ms + 3.165x averaging).
model.candidate_population: N = 2,000 Mode B f=1% candidates: 51.0% working (K=8 lines in [55, 3500] kHz, min gap >= 5 kHz), 24.5% crowded (donor present, min gap < 5 kHz or <8 isolated lines), 24.5% blank (no donor).
model.boed_stages: Stage 0: ESR presence SPRT (~0.5-2 ms); Stage 1: broadband power-broadened survey + local de-crowding early-abort (<15 ms); Stage 2: sequential Fisher-optimal inflection-point (f_hat +/- gamma/sqrt(3)) Bayesian grid updates with stopping rule sigma_post <= 85 Hz.
model.cellisa_v3: Adds BUS_TUNE, BUS_CZ, LOGICAL_ENCODE, WAFER_MAP_ROUTE with full 2-cell cavity-QED dispersive bus simulation (NbTiN Z_r, g, Delta, kappa), dynamic wafer routing on 4x4 heterogeneous grids, SHA-256 certificates, and portable Exp126 32D verification bridge.

predictions.statement: Mean abort latency is < 3.0 ms for blank slots and < 15.0 ms for crowded (< 5 kHz) candidates (vs 1,000 ms legacy fixed sweep).
Stage-2 BOED frequency estimation achieves empirical RMS localization error sigma_f <= 100.0 Hz across all 8 hyperfine lines on working candidates (>=2x sharper than legacy 200 Hz).
Across N=2,000 MC candidates, False Negative Rate (valid register rejected) < 1.0% and False Positive Rate (blank/crowded falsely accepted) < 0.5%.

Effective mean spectroscopy time per attempt drops below 150 ms (>=6.7x readout speedup at $0 hardware cost), lifting factory throughput from 1.97e8 to >= 1.0e9 certified registers/day and reaching/approaching the Arch-B 1024-beamlet @ 15 ms write ceiling (1.49e9 registers/day at 7.54x crossover).

WAFER_MAP_ROUTE achieves >= 90% routability for 4-cell logical clusters on 51%-yield 4x4 wafers; BUS_TUNE + BUS_CZ delivers two-cell entangled state fidelity >= 0.94 with verified SHA-256 MultiCellCertificate and Exp126 32D provenance.
All existing v2.0/v2.1 tests and new Exp132 tests pass 100% with zero hardcoded host paths.

success_rule: DA1, DA2, DA3, DA4, DA5, DA6 all PASS.
